name: Starter hut
about: A quick little hut for your first night, with a bed and a crafting table inside.

layers.name: Walls, bed and table
layers.tip: On flat ground, put a log in each corner and planks between them. Leave the middle of the front open for a door. Put the bed along the back wall and the crafting table beside it.

layers.name: Windows and light
layers.tip: Glass on each side makes two windows. A torch on the crafting table lights it up.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: One more row all the way around. This time the front closes over the door.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the top with oak slabs. Put a door in the gap and close it at night.
